turns.text: Hi Marcus! Happy Monday. How is the new school year treating you so far? Are the high school chemistry classes keeping you busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yeah, it's been pretty busy getting the students settled into the lab routines. I needed a good start to the day, so I made sure to have some oatmeal for breakfast this morning to keep my energy up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move, oatmeal is perfect for a busy morning of teaching. Did you have a chance to unwind after school let out today?

turns.text: I did. I headed over to the fitness center and did some gym weights. It really helps clear my mind after a long day of lecturing.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Weight training is a great way to decompress. Did Grace join you for the workout, or did you fly solo today?

turns.text: She had some of her own things to do, so I just went by myself today. It was a good session though.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sometimes a solo session is just what you need to focus. How is the weather in Portland holding up today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's actually quite nice, typical late August weather. Grace and I are just planning a quiet evening. We're going to watch a cooking competition show tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, those are always so fun to watch! Do you have a favorite one you usually follow, or are you trying something new?

turns.text: We're just checking out a cooking competition show we haven't seen before. It's nice to just zone out and watch people cook under pressure.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely, it's very entertaining. Have you had any time for your woodworking projects lately, or has tennis been taking up your free time?

turns.text: Honestly, with the new school year starting, I haven't had much time for woodworking or tennis. Hopefully, I'll get back to the workshop next weekend!
